summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Locafy Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting its financial results for the first nine months of fiscal 2026. The press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, details a 31% revenue growth, a 36% increase in subscription revenues, and a 36% improvement in net loss. It also notes preparation for the launch of a new platform called Poseidon. The filing contains no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. It is purely an earnings update with no corporate event triggering a special-situation classification.
